title: AddToMap - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Adds this Reference (which must be a map marker) to the Players map, optionally making it available for fast-travel. Syntax: Function AddToMap(bool abAllowFastTravel = False) native Parameters: - abAllowFastTravel: Whether the player can fast-travel to this marker or not. Default: False Return Value: None. Examples: ; Adds this marker to the map MyHouseMarkerProperty.AddToMap()
; Adds this marker to the map, letting the player fast-travel MyHouseMarkerProperty.AddToMap(true) See Also: - Reference - ObjectReference Script - EnableFastTravel - ObjectReference - ShowAllMapMarkers - Game
